resources.string: We paused to keep your wallet safe
SORA found something it couldn\'t check, so it paused. Your keys and accounts were not changed, and they are still on this device.
SORA couldn\'t read your wallet storage just now. This usually passes in a moment. Your keys and accounts were not changed.
SORA paused while finishing an account removal you started. Accounts you didn\'t choose to remove were not changed.
This phone can\'t unlock your wallet
The wallet data saved here can\'t be unlocked on this phone, for example after moving to a new phone. Nothing was deleted. Restore with your recovery phrase or a Google Drive backup.
SORA needs about %1$s MB free to finish updating safely. Your wallet hasn\'t been changed.
Your phone is almost out of space. Free up some space so SORA can finish safely. Your wallet hasn\'t been changed.
You can view balances and history. Sending, swapping and account changes stay off until the upgrade finishes. You can try the upgrade again from the home screen at any time.
SORA will restart like a new install so you can restore your wallet. The wallet data on this phone is kept, and nothing is deleted.
This phone can\'t unlock the old data, so have your recovery phrase or Google Drive password ready.
If you haven\'t written down your recovery phrase yet, show it and write it down first.
This file helps SORA support see what happened. It is not a backup and can\'t restore your wallet on another phone. Share it only with SORA support.
App settings and saved app data, such as transaction history
Your keys in encrypted form, which only this phone can unlock
Your recovery phrase, seed or private keys in readable form
Export created. Your keys stay on this device.
Send these details to SORA support so they can help. Never share your recovery phrase with anyone, including support.
No email app is set up. You can write to %1$s.
Enter your SORA PIN to show your recovery phrase.
That PIN isn\'t right. Try again.
Too many tries. Try again in %1$s.
SORA can\'t check your PIN right now. Try again in a moment.
No SORA PIN is set on this phone. Confirm with your phone\'s screen lock instead.
To show the phrase here, set a screen lock on this phone first.
These recovery phrases are saved on this phone.
Phrase saved by an older SORA version
Write these words down in order and keep them offline. Anyone with this phrase can take your funds.
Write this seed down and keep it offline. Anyone with it can take your funds.
SORA couldn\'t unlock this phrase right now. Try again in a moment.
No recovery phrase or seed is saved for this wallet on this phone.

Keys saved on this phone stay where they are. Restoring the same wallet reuses them after SORA checks that they match. Other wallets whose keys are saved on this phone are then listed in Login & Security, under \"Wallets found on this phone\", so you can restore them one by one.

SORA is setting aside the old wallet data so you can restore. It needs to restart to finish this. The old data stays on this phone, and nothing is deleted. If it keeps stopping here, check that your phone has some free space, or contact support.
Read-only mode can\'t open your wallet data on this phone right now. Nothing was changed. Close this and choose another option.
SORA couldn\'t open read-only mode. Nothing was changed. Try again, or contact support.
SORA couldn\'t create the file. Your wallet data was not changed. Try again, or contact support.
SORA couldn\'t prepare the restore. Nothing was moved or deleted. Try again, or contact support.
An older SORA version saved this phrase. SORA couldn\'t confirm that it belongs to this wallet.
An older SORA version saved this seed. SORA couldn\'t confirm that it belongs to this wallet.
This phone can\'t unlock the saved phrase, so trying again won\'t help. If you wrote it down or backed it up to Google Drive, you can still restore with it.

This phrase opens a different wallet, not this one, so it is not a backup of this wallet. SORA found no recovery phrase for this wallet on this phone. Showing this changes nothing: everything saved on this phone stays as it is. If this wallet works when SORA opens again, back it up by exporting it as an encrypted JSON file (Account options).

This seed opens a different wallet, not this one, so it is not a backup of this wallet. Showing this changes nothing: everything saved on this phone stays as it is. If this wallet works when SORA opens again, back it up by exporting it as an encrypted JSON file (Account options).
